news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹17.88 (vs ₹15.17 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹17.88 (up from ₹15.17 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹35.3b (up 19% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹13.3b (up 18% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 38% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 9.5% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 1.6% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 12% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 25% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: CUB: Upcoming Board Decisions On Dividend And Bonus Issue Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target on City Union Bank to ₹314 from about ₹303, reflecting updated assumptions around slightly higher revenue growth, a modestly different profit margin outlook, and a small change in expected future P/E levels. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for April 27, 2026 to consider the audited standalone financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026 (Key Developments).

news.title: City Union Bank Limited Proposes Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-26
news.body: The Board of Directors of City Union Bank Limited at its meeting held on April 27, 2026 recommended a dividend @ INR 2 /- per equity share i.e., 200% on face value of INR 1/-per equity share of the Bank for the Financial Year 2025-26, the payment of which will be subject to approval by the shareholders of the Bank at the upcoming Annual General Meeting.

news.title: CUB: Upcoming Meetings And Results Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for City Union Bank from ₹310.09 to ₹302.82, reflecting slightly updated assumptions around the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and a modestly lower future P/E multiple. What's in the News A special or extraordinary shareholders meeting is scheduled for April 3, 2026, to be conducted via postal ballot in India.

news.title: CUB: Upcoming Meetings And Quarterly Results Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have made a small adjustment to their price target for City Union Bank, trimming it by about ₹1 to ₹310, as they fine tune assumptions around fair value, discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E. What's in the News A Special or Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting is scheduled for April 3, 2026, to be conducted via postal ballot in India.

news.title: CUB: Upcoming Results And Shareholder Meeting Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have maintained their fair value estimate for City Union Bank at about ₹311 per share, citing largely unchanged assumptions around a discount rate of roughly 14.1%, revenue growth near 11.2% and a future P/E close to 16.3x. These factors together support an unchanged price target narrative.

news.title: CUB: Slightly Refined Assumptions And Upcoming Results Date Will Shape Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have nudged their price target for City Union Bank slightly higher to around ₹311, reflecting small changes in fair value, discount rate, profit margin assumptions and future P/E expectations. What's in the News City Union Bank has scheduled a board meeting for February 2, 2026, to consider and approve the standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, subject to limited review by the Joint Statutory Central Auditors of the bank (Key Developments).

news.title: CUB: Refined Assumptions And Upcoming Results Date Will Support Balanced Outlook
news.body: Analysts have raised their fair value estimate for City Union Bank from about ₹286 to around ₹311, citing slightly lower discount rate assumptions, along with modestly higher expectations for revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E, as the key drivers behind the change. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on February 2, 2026, to consider and approve the standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, subject to limited review by the Joint Statutory Central Auditors of the bank (Key Developments).

news.title: City Union Bank Limited Announces Independent Directors Retirement, Effective February 6, 2026
news.body: City Union Bank Limited informed that Shri V.N. Shivashankar and Dr. T.S. Sridhar, Independent Directors on the Board of the Bank, demitted their office at the close of business hours on February 6, 2026 on account of completion of 8 years tenure in terms of Section 10A(2A)(i) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, as amended. The retirement was communicated in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, ensuring proper disclosure as per SEBI guidelines. The bank adhered to the disclosure requirements outlined in Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations, ensuring transparency in corporate governance. news.title: Price target increased by 8.6% to ₹311
news.body: Up from ₹286, the current price target is an average from 22 analysts. New target price is 6.5% above last closing price of ₹292. Stock is up 63% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹17.73 for next year compared to ₹15.17 last year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.48 (vs ₹3.86 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.48 (up from ₹3.86 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹9.02b (up 22% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.32b (up 16% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 37% (down from 39% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 9.6% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 2.8% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 10% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 23% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
